summary: Backend-only tests for the new cancellation validation flow (Build 152.6). Covered the 3 endpoints (POST /api/applications/{id}/cancel, POST /api/applications/{id}/cancellation/validate, GET /api/applications/received/cancellation-requests) via a pytest suite of 14 tests hitting the public preview URL. All 14 tests passed on first run — the flow works end-to-end, including immediate deletion for pending, requested-status transition for accepted, idempotency 400 on repeated cancel, RBAC (403 for wrong role/owner), slot reopening on approve, refuse behaviour keeping status='accepted' with cancellation_status='refused', enrichment (slot_date/musician_pseudo) on the list endpoint, and DB notifications created with correct types (cancellation_requested / cancellation_approved / cancellation_refused).

minor.issue: Dead code path: after the 'accepted' branch, the check `if status == 'cancelled' or app.get('cancellation_status') == 'requested'` is unreachable for cancellation_status='requested' because that case is already handled inside the 'accepted' branch with a 400. Not a bug, just cleanup.

When role != musician, the 403 message is 'Only musicians can cancel their applications' — check happens BEFORE the app existence lookup, which is correct but note that a venue calling with a non-existent id also gets 403 (role) instead of 404. Consistent with spec.

critical_code_review_comments: planning.py is 1472 lines — should be split into planning_slots.py + applications.py + cancellation.py for maintainability (>700 lines threshold).

cancel_application_v2 has an unreachable branch (case 3) — the `cancellation_status == 'requested'` sub-condition can only be reached if status is neither 'pending' nor 'accepted', which is inconsistent. Minor cleanup.
In validate_cancellation, the venue-not-found case returns 403 instead of 404 (`Venue profile not found`). Semantic mismatch but harmless.
No index on `applications.cancellation_status` — the list_pending_cancellations query filters on it; consider adding a compound index (planning_slot_id, cancellation_status) if volume grows.

seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral planning slots (dates ~400+ days in future, title 'TEST_CancelFlow') + applications + 2 fake DB documents (TEST_fake_* prefixed) for cross-owner RBAC edge cases. All cleaned up in a session-scoped teardown fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_cancellation_flow.py — reusable, self-contained, cleans up its own data via pymongo. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + MONGO_URL from backend/.env. Injects fake application/venue rows to test cross-owner 403s since only one venue and one musician credential are available.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Flow specified in the review request is fully implemented in /app/backend/routes/planning.py lines 1069-1326 and matches all 14 acceptance criteria.
